cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — standing; A sheltered roof above a far-future monorail corridor at night — She tests a paper glider on a narrow bench; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — holds a towel folded against her chest; overgrown jungle temple ruins — holds her keepsake at chest height; A civilian orbital reading room lit by the first pale dawn light — She uses an optical viewer to decipher the folds of a paper puzzle; her bedroom — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — reads a book held open in both hands; a rocky waterfall pool under green trees — lying on her front; an inn kitchen with clay stoves — weaves a few loose flower stems into a small crown in her lap; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — seated on a chair; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — writes with a calligraphy brush and an ink stone on rice paper laid flat on the table; a lit dance stage or milonga floor — holds her keepsake at chest height
